item.title: Transfer: Chelsea set to sign AFCON star, Hadj-Moussa
item.description: Chelsea are said to have started discussions to bring in Feyenoord’s striker, Anis Hadj-Moussa this January, as reported by French media. item.title: Osun targets two million children in Measles Rubella vaccine campaign
item.description: Osun State Government has announced plans to vaccinate more than two million children against measles and rubella as part of a statewide immunisation campaign aimed at strengthening child health and disease prevention. item.title: Sokoto communities under siege as armed groups expand territory
item.description: Communities in Isa Local Government Area of Sokoto State are reeling from renewed bandit attacks, believed to be linked to gunmen loyal to the notorious bandit leader Bello Turji. The violence has forced residents to flee en masse, raising concerns over the expanding influence of armed groups along the Sokoto–Zamfara axis. item.title: Six million residents living with hypertension – Lagos Health Ministry
item.description: Data from the Lagos State Ministry of Health reveal that approximately six million residents are living with hypertension, with a significant portion unaware of their condition. item.title: Popular gospel singer, Bunmi Akinnanu dies
item.description: Popular Nigerian gospel singer, Bunmi Akinnanu, best known for her hit song “Omije Ojumi,” has passed away. item.description: Oyo State Police command says it has arrested no fewer than four (4) people in connection with alleged cases of kidnapping and murder.
